store.name: Long Table
store.tagline: Keepsakes from the photos you share
store.about: Your two rolls meet at long dinners, on mountain trails and on rooftops at dusk. These pieces keep those moments in the colours you both photograph.

products.title: Two Trails Pendant
products.prompt: Pendant necklace in sterling silver: a 20 mm disc with an engraved line that climbs and dips like a trail profile, one polished dot on the line, satin face, on an 18 in cable chain. No stones, no text.
products.why: Mountain hikes are in 26% of your moments together; one design, ordered as a matching pair.

products.title: Long Table Rug
products.prompt: Printed area rug, 5x8 ft, low pile: a long candle-gold band down the centre on a deep forest ground, with small plum ovals along it like plates on a table, shapes at least 6 inches. Flat printed pattern, no fringe, no text.
products.why: Long dinners with friends are in 34% of your moments, the strongest idea in your photos.

products.title: Rooftop Hour Print
products.prompt: Wall art print, 12x16 in, matte paper: stacked flat rooftops in stone and forest under a wide candle-gold sky, simple shapes, wide margins. No text, no landmarks.
products.why: Sunset rooftops are in 15% of your moments.

products.title: Thrift Find Pillow
products.prompt: Printed throw pillow, 18x18 in: a mismatched patchwork of small vintage-style florals and checks in plum, stone and candle-gold. Flat print, hidden zip, no text.
products.why: Vintage shops show up in 17% of your moments.
